chapter.verse: Topa aw, awng-in nang kong sam hi; ka suangpi aw, ka tungah bengngong kei in, tua ci-in kei tungah hong dai dide lecin, Leihawm sunga paisukte tawh a kibang ka suak hi.
Siangthopen mun lamah ka khutte laamto a, nang kiangah huhna kong nget mah bangin, kong thumna aw hong za in.
Amau lungsim sungah siatna om hi napi a vengte tawh kilemna thu a gen khem, siatna bawlte, migilote tawh kei hong lakhia khawm kei in.
Amau sepna leh amau gamtat siatnate bangin amaute thukkik in; amau khut sepna tawh kizui-in thuk in la, amau ngah dinga kilawm thaman pia in.
Amaute in Topa ’ nasepna, a khutte’ nasepna thupi ngaihsut lo ahih manin, amah in amaute susia-in a bawlkik nawn kei ding hi.
Ka thuumna aw hong za ahih manin Topa in thupha ngah ta hen!
Topa in ka hatna leh ka lum hi a, ka lungsim in amah muang hi; tua ahih manin kei hong kihuh a, ka lungsim nuamin diang a, ka lasakna tawh ama tungah lungdamna ka pia hi.
Topa in ama mite’ thahatna hi a, amah in a sathau nilhpa’ kihotkhiatna buk ahi hi.
Na mite hon in la, na luahte thupha pia in; amau cingpa hi in la, a tawntungin amaute huh in.
